The plate spans about 400 px, so I take it as a roughly 26 cm dinner plate, which gives about 15 px per cm.

The food is a small pile of fried rice with some ketchup or chili sauce. It measures about 120 px by 150 px, or roughly 8 cm by 10 cm, but it is thin. I estimate about 90 g of rice, plus about 15 g of sauce and a few scattered bits, for a total of about 105 g.

Fried rice runs about 1.6 kcal/g, so 90 g is about 145 kcal. The sauce adds about 15 kcal. That gives roughly 160 kcal in total.
